name: BYTE PHANTOM
realCapabilities: Cross-platform private IPv4 Network Radar and persistent local journal
Read-only gateway, DNS resolver, transport, interface, local IPv4, and default-route intelligence on Windows and Android
Layered connectivity diagnosis: active route snapshot, one local gateway ICMP echo, system DNS resolution, and two independent HTTPS/TLS checks on Windows and Android

android.nativeBridge: Capacitor 6 Java plugin with bundled capacitor.js JavaScript runtime
android.diagnostics: InetAddress system DNS lookup and HttpURLConnection HTTPS checks

connectivityDiagnostics.gatewayProbe: One ICMP echo request to the active private IPv4 default gateway, when reported and supported
checks: HTTPS/TLS response and status from two fixed endpoints
connectivityDiagnostics.interpretation: A missing gateway ICMP response is inconclusive because routers or firewalls can filter echo requests. HTTPS success proves reachability to at least one test endpoint only.

security: Connectivity diagnostics run only after an explicit user action. They read the active route, send one ICMP echo to the active private IPv4 gateway when available, perform one system DNS lookup and two fixed HTTPS GET checks. They do not scan LAN hosts or ports, test credentials, exploit devices, or modify network settings.
fixes: Rebuilt malformed Windows PowerShell route-diagnostics function
Registered Android NetworkRadar through the Capacitor 6 JavaScript plugin runtime
Packaged capacitor.js into Android and Windows app assets
Restored Windows DNS/HTTPS diagnostics IPC handler and network-path result
Added layered gateway/DNS/HTTPS-TLS failure isolation on Windows and Android
